field.label: Enable
field.help: Enforce parental control. When disabled the alias is emptied, so no device is blocked.

field.label: Alias name
field.help: The firewall alias holding currently blocked devices. Created automatically if missing, along with the rule that blocks it from reaching the internet.

field.label: Drop existing connections
field.help: When a device becomes blocked, drop its established connections. Without this an in-progress stream keeps running until it ends by itself.
